rules.description: Light Abilities are special Abilities that take Energy to use and are based on Connection type.
rules.connection_requirement: A Character can only gain a Light Ability if they have a matching Connection. Universal Connections can be taken by any Character regardless of their Connections.
rules.category_selection: A Character can take any amount of each Light Ability category to fill their Light Ability Slots.
rules.default_action: All Light Abilities are a Half Action to use unless specified otherwise.

ability_slots.installation: An empty Ability Slot can install a single owned Light Ability at a time.
ability_slots.between_missions: Once a Character purchases a Light Ability, they keep it and can freely switch it in and out of Ability Slots between missions.

supers.description: Supers are powerful versions of Light Abilities that gain extra benefits such as more Damage, a larger radius of effect, or additional effects.
supers.energy_cost: All Super Abilities cost double the Energy to perform and use Super Energy instead of Light Energy.
supers.experience_cost: The Experience Cost of a Super is increased by 50%.
supers.availability: A Character can only have a single Super at a time.
supers.ability_slots: Supers do not take up Light Ability Slots.
supers.purchase: A Super is purchased separately from its base Light Ability.
supers.between_missions: All purchased Supers can be kept and changed out between missions.

grenade_supers.rule: Grenades have a uniform Super outcome. When a Grenade Light Ability is selected as a Super, the Character can use 2 Grenades during the same Half Action.

energy.light_energy: Light Energy is used to cast normal Light Abilities.
energy.super_energy: Super Energy is used only to cast Supers.
energy.turn_regeneration: At the beginning of each Turn, the Character regains 5 Light Energy and 5 Super Energy.
energy.normal_defeat_regeneration: Each time the Character defeats an enemy using normal means, such as standard combat and weapons, they regain 5 Light Energy and 5 Super Energy.
energy.light_ability_defeat_regeneration: Each time the Character defeats an enemy using Light Abilities, they regain 10 Super Energy per Turn.
energy.ally_support_regeneration: Each time the Character uses a Light Ability to buff, assist, or heal an ally, they regain 5 Super Energy per Turn.

double_jump.availability: All Guardians can perform a Double Jump.
double_jump.description: A Double Jump allows a Character to perform a Jump or Leap while already midair.
double_jump.limitations: Unless specified otherwise, a Double Jump can only be used once while in the air and cannot be used until the Character makes full contact with a surface they can stand on.
double_jump.action: A Double Jump is a Half Action and works as a normal Jump or Leap unless performed using a Light Ability.
double_jump.falling_damage: The Character takes no Falling Damage from the height gained from Double Jumps, including Double Jumps boosted by Light Abilities and Supers.
